normalization_plan.reason: The newImplementation parameter is only consumed by _setImplementation for the storage write.
The newAdmin parameter is only consumed by _setAdmin for the storage write.
The _logic parameter is only used to set the implementation during construction.
The _data parameter is only used as delegatecall payload during construction.
The _admin parameter is only used by initialize to set the admin slot.
The implementation parameter is only consumed by _delegate as the delegatecall target.
The account parameter is only used to read extcodesize inside isContract.
The data parameter is only consumed as the delegatecall payload of upgradeToAndCall.
The local slot variable is a temporary alias of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT inside _setImplementation.
The impl local is the return value assembled inside _implementation.
The success local only captures the delegatecall status checked by upgradeToAndCall.
The size local only captures the extcodesize result inside isContract.
The adm local is the return value assembled inside _admin.
